verdict.rationale: ZCode is an AI coding workbench built around its own agent: a terminal Agent, multi-agent collaboration toward complex goals, and Goal-based planning, execution and verification. Hands-on users report the built-in agent 'works pretty well' and praise it as a harness, though one user hit frequent API connection errors. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how tasks are delegated (the evidence is mostly marketing-level), and evidence of consistent reliability given the reported EPIPE failures.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: ZCode 是 AI 编程工作台，提供桌面应用、浏览器界面和终端 Agent。
